description: Total chargeback cost per deployment or Serverless project over a recent window, in the configured currency, including the chargeback_group tag. Use this first to see who spends what and to pick a deployment worth drilling into. IMPORTANT: this tool does NOT tell you whether a deployment is Hosted or Serverless, and a blank deployment_name is not proof of either. Call chargeback.deployment_inventory to classify before giving platform-specific advice. days = lookback window in days.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON @timestamp >= conf_start_date AND @timestamp <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL cost = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS cost = SUM(cost), chargeable_units = SUM(total_chargeable_units), days_covered = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp)
    BY deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_group
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 50
